name: DROWL Media
description: DROWL media (entity) default configurations and enhancements.
project_description:
DROWL media (entity) default configurations and enhancements. Furthermore better style for the Media Library & Media Library items preview (eg. in reference fields). Style enhancements requires the usage of the GIN or Claro theme (prefer the first one, we don't actively maintain the Claro styles).

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 5.x 
 
 Based on 4.x 
 Swiper insted of Slick / Blazy version of 4.x - needs manual updates where Slick / Blazy was used! 
 Requires drowl_media 5.x 
 
 4.x 
 4.x is the successor of 3.x making the switch to Drupal Core Media field names:

 
 field_document => field_media_document 
 field_image => field_media_image 
 field_video_file => field_media_video_file 
 
 ([#3426028])

Furthermore, other fields were added or cleaned up, see [#3443688]

 The media templates in 4.x were switched from Foundation to Bootstrap ([#3436181]) but 4.x will generally also allow to be used with Foundation by overriding and updating the templates.

 Future development will happen in 4.x. Upgrading may involve larg manual steps, so consider whether it is worth it, take time and handle with care! 

 
 Upgrade path is not complete until all tasks above are solved and the upgrade path is tested! Until that, all existing pages based on the old 3.x foundation branch should NOT update to 4.x! 
 We've moved the bootstrap templates into the 4.x module. When upgrading from 3.x to 4.x on an existing foundation project, the foundation templates need to be used and the changed field names in the templates need to be updated accordingly ! 
 
 See [#3443688] for progress!

 3.x / 8.x-2.x 
 3.x is the SemVer successor of 8.x-2.x containing default stylesheets missing in 8.x-2.x.

Use 3.x for Drupal 9 and 8.x-2.x for Drupal 8 (deprecated) - required due to Core Theme changes in Drupal 9. 

 We're planning to keep 3.x supported and recommended for the future for existing Foundation sites with minimum maintenance 

 
 NO UPGRADE PATH FROM 1.x! 
 Designed for Media in Core 
 Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 
 1.x 
 
 Designed for Media Entity module 
 NO Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 Deprecated
